item.description: #NoStatuteOfLimitations ◾️ On September 1-3, 2004, Russia endured one of the most horrific tragedies in its modern history – the inhuman Beslan terrorist attack . 22 years ago , a festive back-to-school ceremony at School No.1 was shattered by bursts of gunfire. The terrorists took 1,128 people hostage – children, their parents and teachers. They were forced into a cramped gymnasium, which the terrorists turned into a deadly trap. For nearly three days, the hostages were held at gunpoint without food or water. For hundreds of families, those three days lasted an eternity. During the counterterrorism operation , 811 people were rescued. But, to our great sorrow, not all could be saved. 🕯 The terrorist attack claimed 334 lives, including 186 children. We remember and mourn the children, their parents and teachers who perished during those terrible September days . #NoStatuteOfLimitations
◾️
On September 1-3, 2004, Russia endured one of the most horrific tragedies in its modern history –
the inhuman
Beslan terrorist attack
.
22 years ago
, a festive back-to-school ceremony at
School No.1
was shattered by bursts of gunfire.
The terrorists took 1,128 people hostage – children, their parents and teachers.
They were forced into a cramped gymnasium, which the terrorists turned into a deadly trap. For nearly three days, the hostages were held at gunpoint without food or water.
For hundreds of families, those three days lasted an eternity.
During
the counterterrorism operation
,
811 people were rescued.
But, to our great sorrow,
not all could be saved.
🕯
The terrorist attack claimed 334 lives, including 186 children.
We remember and mourn
the children, their parents and teachers who perished during those terrible September days
.
We bow our heads
before the courage of those who entered the school rigged with explosives, carried children out under fire and rescued hostages, risking and sacrificing their own lives.
Beslan will forever remain our shared pain – a wound that does not heal with time.
💬
As President of Russia
Vladimir Putin
said
on September 4, 2004:
What happened in Beslan was
an
inhuman terrorist crime, unprecedented in its cruelty.
It was a challenge to all of Russia, to our entire people. It was an attack on our country.
The terrorists believe they are stronger than us. That they can intimidate us with their cruelty, paralyse our will and tear our society apart. And it may seem that we have a choice – to fight back or accept their demands. To surrender, to allow Russia to be destroyed and torn apart in the hope that they will eventually leave us alone.
I am convinced that in reality we simply have no choice.
We were and always will be stronger than them
– through our moral values, our courage and our human solidarity. I saw that again last night.
***
In memory of the victims of Beslan and other terrorist attacks,
Russia observes
the Day of Solidarity in the Fight Against Terrorism
on September 3.
On this day, we remember all our compatriots
who were killed by terrorists in Beslan, at Dubrovka, in Budyonnovsk, in the apartment bombings in Moscow, Buynaksk and Volgodonsk, in the
horrific Crocus City Hall tragedy
, at the hands of Ukrainian militants in Donbass and the Kursk Region, in other terrorist attacks.
❗️
Russia considers it its duty to consistently combat international terrorism,
promote the consolidation of international efforts against this pure evil and counter all its manifestations – including those perpetrated by neo-Nazis in Ukraine and other ideological followers of misanthropic ideologies.
Despite the hybrid war unleashed against us – against Russia and the Russian people – by the “collective West”, including through terrorist and extremist groups of all stripes,
Russia remains firmly committed to a principled fight against the terrorist threat and to strengthening counterterrorism security,
relying on cooperation with partners genuinely interested in this work.
–
briefing
by Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman
Maria Zakharova
,
August 28, 2024
📷
©
Head of the Republic of North Ossetia – Alania Sergey Menyaylo

new wave of anti-Russian information campaign that is fuelled in EU Member States at the instigation of Berlin
, the EU “strongly condemned” the afore-mentioned drone “incident”, expressed its “full solidarity” with Germany and confirmed its plans to take “appropriate measures” against Moscow. It was also reiterated that the

.

firmly rejected the new unfounded allegations of the EU
. He noted that the new drone provocation, this time in Leipzig, was intended to
divert the attention of the Europeans from the increasingly deteriorating socio-economic situation in the EU and the crisis of confidence in relation to its political elites, particularly in Germany.

y, as well as in the destruction of Russian civilian infrastructure. It was emphasized that the
actions of terrorists, their accomplices and sponsors will not be left without due legal consequences.

item.description: 🇷🇺 🇿🇦 Russia and South Africa Strengthen Cooperation on Human Rights On 2 September 2026, the latest round of Russia–South Africa consultations on human rights was held in Pretoria. During the meeting between Grigory Lukyantsev, Director of the Russian MFA’s Department for Humanitarian Cooperation and Human Rights, and Ambassador Xolisa Mabhongo, Deputy Director-General of the South African Department of International Relations and Cooperation, both sides reaffirmed their commitment to building a trust-based dialogue grounded in mutual respect and consideration of national interests. Particular attention was paid to coordinating efforts in international fora, primarily the #UN , as well as countering the politicisation of human rights and its use as a tool of geopolitical pressure and unfair competition. item.title: ⚡️ Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency #Rosaviatsiya Ukraine’s aviation authorities have backed the terrorist rhetoric of their leadership
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency ( #Rosaviatsiya ) Ukraine’s aviation authorities have backed the terrorist rhetoric of their leadership aimed at disrupting the operation of Russia’s civil aviation and issued an illegitimate NOTAM alleging that Russian airspace is unsafe. In response, Rosaviatsiya issued a NOTAM stating that all documents published by Ukraine concerning Russian airspace have no legal force and violate the Convention on International Civil Aviation. ❗️ Russia’s air transport system and ground infrastructure continue to operate as normal, receiving and dispatching flights, including those of foreign airlines. Rosaviatsiya, in coordination with other federal and regional authorities, is implementing additional measures to ensure the safe use of Russian airspace and strengthen the security of transport infrastructure on the ground.

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : 💬 On September 1, a volunteer humanitarian convoy – four vehicles carrying food and medicines – was attacked by Ukrainian drones while approaching the city of Alyoshki in the Kherson Region. For several months, Ukrainian militants have been using drone strikes and remote mining to obstruct civilian traffic, including ambulances, travelling to and from Alyoshki. According to eyewitnesses, a Ukrainian drone hovered in front of the lead vehicle , forcing the volunteer group to stop. The drone then circled all the vehicles, giving its operator ample opportunity to verify that they were carrying only civilians and humanitarian cargo. The first vehicle was then struck by a Ukrainian UAV. Further strikes on the civilian vehicles followed one after another until the cars were badly damaged and the aid cargo destroyed . The drivers and volunteers accompanying the shipment managed to leave the vehicles and take cover in a nearby wooded area. According to preliminary information , one volunteer was injured . ❗️ An attack on civilian vehicles and civilians is unequivocally a war crime. This attack is further aggravated by the fact that the volunteers were carrying out a humanitarian mission to the city, which was deliberately disrupted.

item.title: 🗓 On August 31 – September 1, 2026, President of Russia Vladimir Putin visited Bishkek
item.description: 🗓 On August 31 – September 1, 2026, President of Russia Vladimir Putin visited Bishkek , where he took part in the events of the anniversary Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation ( #SCO ), marking the Organisation’s 25th anniversary. Key events of the anniversary Summit: 👏 Opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games 🎙 Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State 🎙 SCO Plus meeting 💬 From Vladimir Putin’s remarks at the meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State: Over the past 25 years, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation has come a long way, becoming one of the independent and influential centres of the emerging #MultipolarWorld . Today, the SCO is effectively the largest regional association not only on our common Eurasian continent, but in the world as a whole. Its member states account for almost half of the world’s population and more than one-third of global GDP. ✍️ Following the meeting, a package of 28 documents was adopted, including the Bishkek Declaration on the 25th Anniversary of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation . *** 🤝 On the sidelines of the Summit, Vladimir Putin held bilateral meetings with: 🇨🇳 President of China Xi Jinping 🇮🇳 Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi 🇺🇿 President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev 🇰🇿 President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev 🇮🇷 President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian 🇹🇯 President of Tajikistan Emomali Rahmon 🇹🇷 President of Turkiye Recep Tayyip Erdogan 🇲🇳 President of Mongolia Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh 🇦🇲 Prime Mini

On August 31 – September 1, 2026,
President of Russia Vladimir Putin
visited Bishkek
, where he took part in the events of the
anniversary Summit of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
(
#SCO
), marking the Organisation’s 25th anniversary.
Key events of the anniversary Summit:
👏
Opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games
🎙
Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State
🎙
SCO Plus meeting
💬
From
Vladimir Putin’s remarks
at the meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State:
Over the past 25 years, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation has come a long way, becoming one of the independent and influential centres of the emerging
#MultipolarWorld
.
Today, the SCO is effectively the largest regional association not only on our common Eurasian continent, but in the world as a whole.
Its member states account for almost half of the world’s population and more than one-third of global GDP.
✍️
Following the meeting,
a package of 28 documents
was adopted, including
the Bishkek Declaration on the 25th Anniversary of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
.
